text_block_list.text:
A special airport collaboration 
merchandise line for <chrname> was approved. On the 
day Chairwoman Akikawa and I went out for 
the final check――

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Splendid! The collab menu, merchandise, 
and exhibits were all completed with 
exquisite quality!
choice_data_list:
Now that we're done checking, shall we 
head back to the academy?

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Nay! Due to subsequent plans, I must 
remain here and wait!

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
I am scheduled to meet with Mother in an 
hour.

The 'Mother' of Chairwoman Akikawa, whom 
I'd heard about before— the former 
chairwoman of Tracen Academy.

Due to her extraordinary talent, foreign 
nations strongly urged her to dedicate 
herself to Umamusumes worldwide, so she 
stepped down and moved her base overseas, 
it seems.

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Apparently, due to a flight layover, 
she'll be able to stay in Japan for about 
three hours.

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Indeed! Mother is someone who supports 
Umamusume around the world. Just recently, 
she flew off to South America and Oceania 
without even stopping by Japan.

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Mother will be in Japan for three whole 
hours. ...It is a rare opportunity.

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
That is why, during this stay, I intend to 
show Mother what I have learned.

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Indeed! It's the soap you bought for me 
before!

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
I want to tell Mother... that her 
successor has grown enough to truly suit 
this fragrance.

And—having no subsequent plans scheduled, 
I decided to accompany Chairwoman Akikawa 
for the hour until her flight arrived.

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
I've already picked out the restaurant 
where I'll dine with Mother! Hehe, getting 
the reservation was quite the ordeal, you 
know.

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
I brought souvenirs from Japan too! 
Beautiful, sparkling origami paper! 
Apparently, it's really popular at 
Mother's workplace!

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
...When I see them, what should I talk 
about first? I'll definitely start with 
how much taller I've gotten—!

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
――……Whoa, an entire hour has passed 
already?! Time flies when I'm with you!

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
I know! If you still have time, why don't 
you come meet Mother? Knowing you—
(Bzzt, bzzt)

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
...Speak of the devil! Well now, 
Mothe—...?

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
――……The flight's delayed? So until we 
land, we're……

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
My apologies! Trainer <username>, it is unfortunate, 
but it appears I must head back now.
choice_data_list:
What?! But the Chairwoman's mother is 
still...

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
I received an email. It seems the arrival 
will be delayed by about three hours. It 
will likely be evening by the time they 
arrive.

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
However, even I cannot wait that long. 
Unfortunately, I still have meetings and 
work left to attend to today.

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
...Mother would have done the exact same 
thing in my position.

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
We have a duty to uphold. If decisions or 
work are delayed at the top, those who 
suffer the most are――the umamusume.

I understand the importance of the 
Chairwoman's duties. However, meetings can 
be held online, and there may be work we 
can help with!

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
Thank you for waiting, Trainer <username>. The web 
meeting with the URA concluded without 
issue.

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
To think there was a whole rental space 
available for rent right near the 
airport... This will certainly maintain 
confidentiality.

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Y-Yes! A-And you too, Mei! To think you 
would personally bring the documents over!

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
Haha. When someone asks that desperately, 
I gotta deliver. Thanks for reaching out 
to me too, Trainer <username>.
choice_data_list:
The pleasure's mine, thanks for your 
cooperation!

text_block_list.text:
We hastily leased rental space after that. 
Thanks to extensive local cooperation, we 
managed to set up an environment where the 
Chairwoman could work near the airport.
choice_data_list:
Chairwoman, is this everything for the 
essential work?

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Y-Yes. Thanks to you all helping out, all 
the work we needed to do has been...
(Click...)

text_block_list.name: Former Academy Chairwoman
text_block_list.text:
...The fact that people are willing to 
move for your sake is proof of how much 
you've devoted yourself to those around 
you.

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text: ...Mother?

text_block_list.name: Former Academy Chairwoman
text_block_list.text:
...You've grown so admirable, Yayoi. Sorry 
I'm late.

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
.........! M-Mother...!! Th-The real...! 
Ah... Waaaaaaaahhhh...!

Tears welled up in Chairwoman Akikawa's 
eyes as she hugged her mother. We all 
stepped away to give the two of them some 
time alone――
